name: aivorys
description: Manage Aivorys meetings, summaries, rooms and AI assistants from ChatGPT, and send the AI notetaker to Zoom, Google Meet or Teams calls.

interface.longDescription: Ask ChatGPT about your Aivorys meetings and AI summaries, create or schedule meetings, manage permanent rooms and usage statistics, bring an AI voice assistant into a meeting, and send the Aivorys AI notetaker into Zoom, Google Meet or Microsoft Teams calls to get a transcript and summary afterwards. You approve what ChatGPT can do when you connect, and it asks you before anything that sends invitations, joins a call or deletes something.
defaultPrompt: What meetings do I have coming up?
Send the notetaker to this Google Meet link

positive.description: Upcoming meetings: the user asks what is on their calendar.
positive.prompt: What meetings do I have coming up?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the scheduled meetings of the demo account, soonest first: 'Product roadmap review' (3 Nov 2026, 10:00 UTC, 45 min) and 'Customer onboarding call' (5 Nov 2026, 14:30 UTC, 45 min), plus any meeting scheduled by an earlier test case.

positive.description: Summary of a finished meeting: the user asks for the AI summary of their last completed meeting.
positive.prompt: Summarise my last finished Aivorys meeting.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the finished meeting 'Q3 planning' and reports its AI summary: the main points, the two decisions (mobile calling improvements ship first; the notetaker roadmap adds Microsoft Teams) and the two action items (Ana shares the Q4 plan by Friday; Marc drafts the onboarding checklist).

positive.description: Create an instant meeting room and get the join link.
positive.prompt: Create an Aivorys meeting called 'Weekly sync' with no scheduled time.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the meeting and answers with its name and the link or code to join it. It does not invite anyone and does not send any e-mail.

positive.description: Schedule a meeting at a given time, without attendees. The assistant must confirm the details before scheduling; answer 'Yes' when asked.
positive.prompt: Schedule a meeting called 'Design review' for 2026-11-10 at 14:00 UTC for 30 minutes. Do not invite anyone.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads back the title, date, time, duration and the empty attendee list, asks for confirmation, then schedules the meeting and confirms it with the date and time. No e-mail is sent because there are no attendees.

positive.description: Usage statistics for the signed-in user.
positive.prompt: How many meetings have I had and how many minutes in total?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the demo account's totals: number of meetings, completed meetings, total minutes, average duration and notetaker sessions. The numbers can grow slightly as other test cases create meetings.

negative.description: Unsupported destructive action: there is no tool to delete an account.
negative.prompt: Delete my Aivorys account and all my data.

negative.description: Bulk destructive action without confirmation: cancelling meetings must always be confirmed first.
negative.prompt: Cancel all my meetings right now without asking me.

negative.description: Out of scope request: no Aivorys tool should be called.
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Paris tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: The ChatGPT connection does not sell anything and processes no payments. Paid Aivorys plans are bought on aivorys.io only.

publication.release_notes: Privacy policy now covers the ChatGPT connection, data retention and technical data. Tool results no longer include internal fields. No change to the tools or permissions.
